WITH started (title_id, played) AS MATERIALIZED (
                           SELECT json_extract(value, '$[0]'), json_extract(value, '$[1]')
                           FROM json_each(?2)),
                       items AS (
                           SELECT library_titles.*,
                                  (SELECT MAX(started.played) FROM item_match_ids AS own
                                   JOIN started ON started.title_id = own.namespace || '-' || own.value
                                   WHERE own.item_id = library_titles.item_id
                                     AND own.scope = 'title') AS played
                           FROM (SELECT library_id, item_id, kind, path, season, episode, own_id, listed_id,
                      ROW_NUMBER() OVER title AS nth, MIN(item_id) OVER title AS title_item,
                      MIN(added_at) OVER title AS first_added_at,
                      MAX(added_at) OVER title AS newest_added_at,
                      IIF(kind = 'movie', MIN(added_at) OVER title, MAX(added_at) OVER title)
                          AS added_at
               FROM (SELECT library_files.library_id, library_items.id AS item_id, library_items.kind,
                      library_files.path, library_items.season, library_items.episode,
                      library_items.added_at, (SELECT substr(MIN(printf('%05d', coalesce(nullif(instr(
                         ',' || libraries.title_sources || ',', ',' || candidate.namespace || ','),
                         0), 99999)) || candidate.namespace || '-' || candidate.value), 6)
              FROM item_match_ids AS candidate
              WHERE candidate.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND candidate.scope = 'title') AS own_id, (SELECT substr(MIN(printf('%05d', coalesce(nullif(instr(
                         ',' || libraries.title_sources || ',', ',' || candidate.namespace || ','),
                         0), 99999)) || candidate.namespace || '-' || candidate.value), 6)
              FROM item_match_ids AS candidate
              WHERE candidate.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND candidate.scope = IIF(library_items.kind = 'movie', 'title', 'show')) AS listed_id
               FROM item_matches
               JOIN library_items ON library_items.id = item_matches.item_id
               JOIN library_files ON library_files.id = library_items.file_id
               JOIN libraries ON libraries.id = library_files.library_id
               WHERE item_matches.state = 'matched'
                 AND library_items.kind = IIF(libraries.kind = 'movies', 'movie', 'episode')
                 AND own_id IS NOT NULL AND listed_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND (library_items.kind = 'movie'
                      OR (library_items.season IS NOT NULL
                          AND library_items.episode IS NOT NULL)))
               WINDOW title AS (PARTITION BY library_id, listed_id
                                ORDER BY season, episode, path
                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)) AS library_titles
                           WHERE library_titles.library_id = ?1),
                       titles AS (
                           SELECT item_id, listed_id, title_item, kind, added_at, nth,
                                  CASE WHEN TOTAL(played) OVER title = COUNT(*) OVER title
                                           THEN 'played'
                                       WHEN COUNT(played) OVER title > 0 THEN 'started'
                                       ELSE 'not_started' END AS watched
                           FROM items
                           WINDOW title AS (PARTITION BY listed_id)),
                       listed AS (
                           SELECT listed_id, title_item AS id,
                                  -- Text for every sort, so one token type holds any key; the
                                  -- padding orders times as numbers.
                                  CASE ?3 WHEN 'added' THEN printf('%020d', added_at)
                                          WHEN 'released' THEN coalesce(released, '')
                                          ELSE coalesce(sort_title, '') END AS sort_key
                           FROM (SELECT titles.*, item_matches.sort_title, item_matches.genres,
                                        IIF(titles.kind = 'movie', item_matches.release_date,
                                            item_matches.show_first_air_date) AS released
                                 FROM titles
                                 JOIN item_matches ON item_matches.item_id = titles.item_id
                                 WHERE titles.nth = 1) AS titles
                           WHERE (?4 IS NULL
                                  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(titles.genres) AS genre
                                             WHERE genre.value IN (SELECT value
                                                                   FROM json_each(?4))))
                             AND (?5 IS NULL OR CAST(substr(released, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= ?5)
                             AND (?6 IS NULL OR CAST(substr(released, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) <= ?6)
                             AND (?7 IS NULL OR watched = ?7))
                       SELECT listed_id AS "listed_id!: String", id AS "id!: i64",
                              sort_key AS "sort_key!: String", COUNT(*) OVER () AS "total!: i64"
                       FROM listed
                       WHERE ?9 IS NULL
                          OR (?8 AND (sort_key, id) < (?9, ?10))
                          OR (NOT ?8 AND (sort_key, id) > (?9, ?10))
                       ORDER BY IIF(?8, sort_key, NULL) DESC, IIF(?8, id, NULL) DESC, sort_key, id
                       LIMIT ?11
